final: WITH member_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), stats AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(member_count) as avg_per_group FROM member_counts) SELECT mc.link_to_major, mc.member_count, CAST(mc.member_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_members as fraction, CAST(mc.member_count AS FLOAT) / s.avg_per_group as ratio_to_avg FROM member_counts mc CROSS JOIN stats s ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10    -- The query from round 1 fully answers the question: groups members by major (with null for no-major), calculates the exact fraction and ratio without rounding, and sorts by ratio descending showing the top 10 groups
